report.title: Adversarial fuzz session: all workers passed
report.subtitle: Template-rendered worker panels in one generated HTML report

summary.text: One primary coordinator dispatched four independent workers. Each worker ran one bounded fuzz task and returned a structured result; the report sections are the exact XHTML panels rendered from the worker-panel template.

runs.description: Malformed files, invalid var-file boundaries, and stable diagnostics
Baseline parity, JSON/YAML equivalence, and deterministic output
Nested JSON/YAML values, jagged arrays, and object nesting
Jinja loops, conditionals, whitespace, and optional values

sections.title: shape-probe
sections.summary: The shape worker exercised recorded structured-input cases. The real jagged-array fixture used rows [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5]] and produced the expected two-row output.
sections.context_text: Successful shape-probe session: 12 iterations, including shape-probe-002 with rows [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5]], all passed.

sections.title: template-probe
sections.summary: The template worker exercised the recorded Jinja behavior cases, including nested control flow and optional values. All bounded inputs produced expected text.
sections.context_text: Successful template-probe session: 12 loop, conditional, whitespace, and optional-value iterations all passed.

sections.title: boundary-probe
sections.summary: The boundary worker exercised malformed-input, diagnostic, and path-confinement cases from the recorded boundary-probe task. Every input reached its expected boundary.
sections.context_text: Successful boundary-probe session: 12 malformed-input, diagnostic, and path-confinement iterations all passed.

sections.title: differential-probe
sections.summary: The differential worker compared baseline/head behavior and repeated renders across the recorded cases. Outputs remained equivalent and deterministic.
sections.context_text: Successful differential-probe session: 12 baseline, parity, and determinism iterations all passed.

footer.text: Generated mock. Future artifacts use site/reports/YYYYMMDD-N-fuzz-report.html and worker-suffixed XHTML panels.
